title: Evaluation of the exactly-one formula
statement: For every finite list $vs$ of natural numbers and every Boolean assignment $a$ to the natural numbers, the exactly-one formula evaluates to true if and only if there is some $j$ appearing in $vs$ such that, for every $v$ appearing in $vs$, $a(v)$ is true exactly when $v=j$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list $vs$ of natural numbers
A Boolean assignment on the natural numbers
